title: Let’s All Dance and Play Mathematics Innovative Teaching of Mathematics
content: Influential topics in innovative teaching practice of mathematics are covered in this work, namely employing dancing and physical education (PE) as powerful and favourable dynamics to lead innovative mathematics’ teaching. So, by default, the current work briges a unified approach to teach mathemtatics via two interdisciplaries, namely, dancing and physical education. Funadmentally, this paper includes a variety of resources appropriate for scholars, researchers, and students studying mathematics. On another strong note, a plethora of influential open problems are introduced to provide food for thought to the research community to steer ahead a new era of contemporary teaching of mathematics.
